Trustible | Senior Engineers (Agentic Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer) | Arlington, VA (DC Area) | Hybrid (2-3 days in office) | 145k-165k + equity | Full Time

We're an AI Governance software company helping organizations navigate emerging AI regulation and risk. Our platform helps organizations build a high quality AI inventory, and automates various risk assessments, reviews, and compliance workflows needed for the EU AI Act, ISO 42001, or the NIST AI RMF. We're building a lot of agentic features and are looking for engineers familiar with AI engineering, or experience integrating with hyperscaler MLOps platforms.

We're looking for people who want to work on on building trustworthy and responsible AI systems.

Apply: trustible.ai/careers
